# arin_ticket_attachment (Data Source)

Read an existing ticket attachment as base64 without writing files. Content is sensitive and stored in Terraform state. The shared 4 MiB response limit applies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
# Set ARIN_API_KEY in the environment.
# This data source stores sensitive content in Terraform state.
data "arin_ticket_attachment" "example" {
  ticket_number = "20260922-X1"
  message_id    = 1
  attachment_id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attachment_id` (String, Sensitive) Existing attachment ID within the message.
- `message_id` (Number, Sensitive) Existing message ID within the ticket.
- `ticket_number` (String, Sensitive) Existing ARIN ticket number. The API key must have access to the ticket.

### Read-Only

- `content_base64` (String, Sensitive) content base64 returned by ARIN.
- `content_type` (String, Sensitive) content type returned by ARIN.
- `filename` (String, Sensitive) filename returned by ARIN.
- `sha256` (String, Sensitive) sha256 returned by ARIN.
- `size_bytes` (Number, Sensitive) size bytes returned by ARIN.
